Policy: Channel Lifecycle Management

Rule 1: Create New Temporary Channels

WHEN:
The daily check at noon of an external Google Sheets request spreadsheet shows new temporary channel request(s).
Ignore malformed rows, such as those containing missing or corrupted data.

PROCEDURE:
- Collect relevant fields for each new channel request from spreadsheet: timestamp, email (requester), proposed channel name, purpose of channel, temporary flag, proposed expiry date, additional comments
- <Optional LLM workflow here to filter out duplicates/inappropriate requests>
- Directly message 3 randomly selected moderators for approval with request details
- The time limit for the approval process is set for 24 hours, after which results are tallied
- A "YES" vote is indicated by each moderator through a thumbsup reaction (👍) to the corresponding message. All other reactions or a lack of reaction is a "NO" vote
- If unanimously approved (3/3 YES votes), create the channel with the appropriate settings, including marking it as temporary
- Send a message in the new channel outlining the channel purpose and, if an end date was configured, when the channel expires
- Notify the requester of the outcome via direct message
- If configured, at lifecycle end date, archive the channel and notify affected users of the closure through direct message

Rule 2: Remove Inactive Temporary Channels

WHEN:
When checking on the first day of the month, a channel has no message activity in the last 30 days.
The channel must be a temporary channel with no configured lifecycle end date.

PROCEDURE:
- Provide a 24 hour notice of channel removal message in the corresponding channel
- Notify all moderators via direct message with a list of inactive channels pending removal
- In the 24 hour period, moderators may overrule the channel removal by replying "overruled" to the channel removal message
- After the 24 hour period, archive all channels marked for removal aside from those overruled by moderators

options.description: Channel lifecycle management with spreadsheet integration, moderator voting, and scheduled archival
